description: This PHP source file handles exporting keywords associated with test projects in the TestLink application. It includes functions to initialize arguments, perform exports in CSV or XML formats, and generate the necessary download content, integrating with the application's templates and user session management.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: A class representing keywords, with a method to get supported serialization interfaces.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates arguments for the export process, retrieving project name and user info.

methods.name: do_export
methods.description: Performs the export operation in the specified format and triggers file download.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI parameters for the export interface.

methods.name: exportKeywordsToCSV
methods.description: Converts a set of keywords into CSV format.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view keywords for a project.
